# Why your SIP needs a crash

Market downturns can be nerve-wracking, but for SIP investors, they are not necessarily bad news. In fact, a crash can improve the overall returns of your SIP by allowing you to accumulate more units at lower prices. This 'rupee cost averaging' effect is a powerful tool that rewards disciplined investors who stay the course.

# Finding the right multi-asset fund

Multi-asset funds invest across equities, debt, and gold, offering diversification. To pick the right one, look beyond the name and examine the actual asset allocation. Consider how the fund’s mix aligns with your risk appetite and financial goals. Also, check the fund manager’s strategy and historical performance across different market cycles.
